notes.title: Developer Update - July 2022
notes.content:
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/BoatDevUpdate.png[/img]

Hey Tamers,

It’s a date! It is nearly time to embark on the Isles, with the official launch date being announced for 6th October 2022. You can read more about this in our [url=https://untamedisles.com/untamed-isles-announces-pre-sale-and-release-date/]Official press release[/url].

With just a few months until launch, let’s take a look at what has been done so far.

[h2]Dev Vlog[/h2]
[previewyoutube=5qmtOETRYg0;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, you can [url=https://youtu.be/5qmtOETRYg0]watch the dev vlog[/url] to learn more about this update.

[h2]Teaser Trailer[/h2]
For the best introduction to Untamed Isles, you need to check out our teaser trailer. It has tame encounters. It has snow. It even has a cute Guppy chasing a butterfly. You can watch the full video here. Support our project by liking the video and sharing it with your friends.

[previewyoutube=FSJOK0VUDtY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Pre-order[/h2]
Our pre-order packs are now available to purchase. Kit your character out in exclusive cosmetics, loot some Fragments (premium currency) and be amongst the first to access the Isles.

Support the development of our game and get into a magical world on Untamed Isles! [url=https://buy.untamedisles.com/]Packs are available to purchase here[/url].

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/01-Starter-Pack.jpg[/img]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/02-Wanderer-Pack.jpg[/img]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/03-Adventurer-Pack.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tame generation[/h2]
Some pretty intense development work was needed to make tames generate based on the world around them, but we are so excited to announce this has now been implemented.

Some tame mood types like getting caught in the rain, other mood types only appear at night. Some tame species love spending time in the depths of the swamp, while others prefer the calm of the meadows. While we don’t want to spoil too much for you, here are some of the factors that impact your wild tame encounter:
[b]Biome:[/b] Tame species
[b]Weather & time:[/b] Tame mood
[b]Starting stat allocation, island sector & player level:[/b] Tame level

Long grass is now fully integrated with tame generation so tames will attack you while walking through the grass.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Egg-hatch-gif.gif[/img]

[h2]Island biome[/h2]
Curious about what biomes will be appearing in the Isles?

Map zones and a biome system have now been introduced and will be used for player progression. Here are some of the biomes in the Isles and why you might love them.

[b]Meadow:[/b] A grassy and open area, perfect for tames to play. While a Guang may prefer the open skies in these areas, fluffy Burrl’s prefer areas with more shelter.
[b]Beach:[/b] Who doesn’t love a beach day out? Grumpy Thoona, that’s who! Guppy naturally loves the beach.
[b]Forest:[/b] Many tamers picture thick forestry when thinking of the Isles. Pluff’s in particular love to play in and around the dense trees. Pango prefers areas that are easier to dig through.
[b]Mountain:[/b] Tamers who are wanting to get their step count up and venture through the mountains are sure to be rewarded. Feonii’s love the views from the mountain tops. Chemmy’s don’t like mountains as they prefer areas with more trees to swing from.
[b]Swamp:[/b] “This is my swamp” says Skelt, our nature-loving tame. Brackis also loves to play in the depths of the overgrown swamp.

While every tame species can be found in every region, some are extremely likely to encounter, whereas others are extremely rare.

[h2]New features around the Isles[/h2]
The Isles have been coming to life with even more magical features.

We have introduced a zoning system on Settlement Island for the player to progress through. This means trickier areas will only be unlocked after levelling, helping players only venture through areas in their current skillset.

We have also completed the 3D model of the researcher ship. This ship is steampunk-esque and we can’t wait for you to see it. The dock area has also been updated, you may have noticed a sneak peek on the teaser trailer. Missed it? Watch again closely.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Swamp-biome-wip.gif[/img]

[h2][b]PS[/b][/h2]
The best way to keep up to date with all our updates is to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823300/Untamed_Isles/]wishlist Untamed Isles on Steam[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/untamedislesofficial]join our Discord server[/url]. See you there!

[h2][b]And more:[/b][/h2]
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/DevUpdate_05_July_V2_web.jpg[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/untamedislesofficial][img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Untamed_Isles_Steam_BannerDiscord.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developer Update - June 2022
notes.content:
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/BuildingsDevUpdate.png[/img]

Hey Tamers,

Well, we are halfway through the year and even closer to the early access launch of Untamed Isles. There’s a little bit of something for everyone in this dev update; battlers, collectors and NPC-fanatics can all find a thing or two to enjoy. On that note, let’s press on with it.

[h2][b]Dev Vlog[/b][/h2]
Don’t miss the video version of this update! Watch the new Dev Vlog with Taylor & Bre.

[previewyoutube=Xm_kAsAHRe4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Rare tames[/b][/h2]
If you’re a shiny hunter or a collector, you’re going to want to pay attention to Gemborns and Alphas. This month we coloured some of our gemborn tames. Thoona sculpted out of rose quartz? What about a ruby-style Thoona? If you’re lucky to encounter a wild gemborn tame, make sure you capture it as these tames are incredibly rare!

The fierce Alpha Burrl is also taking shape. This alpha is a bold mix of floofy and toothy. Look at that overbite!

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Gemborne-blog.jpg[/img]
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/Alpha-Burrl-preview.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Combat Improvements[/b][/h2]
Tamers who love to battle will be pleased to hear that our combat system has gone through some serious refinements. The combat system is now easier to understand in battle with readability UI improvements.

We have also introduced a counterplay / adaptability combat mechanic to improve engagement.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/UI-Combat-Update-wev.jpg[/img]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ezgif.com-gif-maker-5.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Wild Tame Encounters[/b][/h2]
Be careful strolling through the long grass, you never know who you might encounter. Devs have been working on programming the wild tame encounters in the long grass.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Tame-encounter.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Tame Combinations[/b][/h2]
Imagine a monster taming game launching with just ten tames. Now imagine with those 10 tames, there are 1,500,000 different visual combinations to capture and battle. [url=https://youtu.be/UUFCRchjTUo]Watch our new video[/url] explaining how limb swapping works in Untamed Isles.

[previewyoutube=UUFCRchjTUo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]NPC’s now chase, wander, and… fall in love?[/b][/h2]
NPCs are now popping up all over the isles. Thanks to our clever devs, they now chase the player (you!) into battle and stroll through the isles looking for adventure.

The art team have crafted all tier 1 faction NPC models in 3D. We’ve been releasing some of the original concept art for NPCs, which it is fair to say our Untamed community have been loving. In p -yet-to-be-released-researcher NPC and Tucker have been shipped.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/tucker-npc-ship.jpg[/img] [u]Fan art by Jie_isles[/u]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/NPC-3D-Preview-2.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Community[/b][/h2]
What says “ooh ahh”, has a curly tail, and hordes a polished crystal? Our cheekiest tame has now been designed with the help of the community. Throughout June our community worked together to select the monkey’s head, body, and colouring. The end result is very cute.

The Untamed community is a creative bunch and this has really shined through during June. The community photoshopped their favourite tames into real world scenarios to help imagine a world full of tames. The community also put their creativity to the test building an Untamed Isles Minecraft server.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Monkey_Pattern_Present.png[/img]

[h2][b]PS[/b][/h2]
The best way to keep up to date with all our updates is to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823300/Untamed_Isles/]wishlist Untamed Isles on Steam[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/untamedislesofficial]join our Discord server[/url]. See you there!

[h2][b]And more[/b][/h2]
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/DevUpdateJune-01-web.jpg[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/untamedislesofficial][img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Untamed_Isles_Steam_BannerDiscord.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developer Update - May 2022
notes.content:
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/MayDevUpdate1080.png[/img]

Hey Tamers!

We are one month closer to the launch of Untamed Isles. The team is busy as always working on the game and building the magical world for all our Tamers to enjoy. Let’s recap what has been happening in May and also have a sneak peek at some exclusive content we haven’t shared until now.

[h3]Taylor’s Video[/h3]
As always, this update is available in video format with your favourite host Taylor.
[previewyoutube=Ti8UqzuMCwY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Character customisation[/h3]
Finally it’s time to add personality to your in-game character. Character customisation is now up and running to help you create unique combinations of appearance and clothing.

We have a selection of cosmetics, tattoos and other customisation options available now with lots more to be added soon. Character customisation will be available to all our tamers participating in next tests. In the meantime, you can have a look at this beautiful video showcasing some of the outfits.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Untamed-Isles-Character-Customisation-2022.gif[/img]

[h3]NPC updates[/h3]
The work on NPCs continued after last month’s progress, and now we have even more updates to share with you. We’ve completed 3D models for Revolutionary, Bandit, Banker, Auctioneer and Merchant NPC and we are so excited for Tamers to meet them on the isles. The team also developed an NPC AI system for more interesting battles and interactions.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Untamed-Isles-Female-Bandit-T1.png[/img]

[h3]Monkey Tame Design - Community Voting[/h3]
This month we also continued a tradition of designing tames with our community. After the Monkey tame (name is still undecided) was created during the stream, we asked the Untamed Community to select their favourite design of this tame’s face. We had a pretty close voting with a couple of options attracting lots of attention, but in the end there was a clear winner. It’s time for the design team to work on the body of this tame and get back to the community for the feedback. Keep an eye on [url=https://discord.gg/untamedislesofficial]our Discord[/url] to participate in future polls!

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Monkey_Tame_Face_Pick_2.png[/img]

[h3]World Updates[/h3]
Seeing how the world of Untamed Isles is coming together is absolutely magical! The work continues on many fronts with the team developing new areas of the Settlement Island as well as making improvements to systems created earlier.

This month, huge progress was made on the weather system, which now reacts with the time of day. There are also new Dungeon environments in development as well as updates being made on professions.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Untamed-Isles-Dynamic-Weather-Winter-2022.gif[/img]

[h3]User Interface[/h3]
Every detail is super important because we want to provide our Tamers with the best user experience possible.

In May, our design team was focused on creating new icons and updating user interface elements. Just have a look at these tames icons, how cute they are! The first version of the game launcher has been completed on both design and programming end, which is a big milestone in the development.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Untamed-Isles-Tame-Icons-2022.jpg[/img]

[h3]Discord spring clean[/h3]
We love our Discord server because it’s the place where our community is most active. To make the server even better, we gave it a spring clean.

You can now see the updated roles for game and community announcements, new channels structure, refreshed rules and faq posts. Next step is introducing more community activities. Make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/untamedislesofficial]join our server[/url] to get the latest news about Untamed Isles!

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/Untamed-Isles-White-ceramic-mug.jpg[/img]

[h3]And more:[/h3]
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/DeveloperUpdate_03_May_V2-1.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/untamedislesofficial][img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Untamed_Isles_Steam_BannerDiscord.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Developer Update - April 2022
notes.content:
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/DevUpdate1080Skelt.png[/img]
Hey Tamers,

It has been another big month in the world of Untamed Isles. The Easter Guppy dropped a few treats for tamers including new merch, new combat updates, and some new content drops. Let’s get right into some of the exciting development updates.

[url=https://youtu.be/TJSNLJWiJJU]Taylor also talks us through the latest updates in a video[/url]:

[previewyoutube=TJSNLJWiJJU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Combat changes[/b][/h3]
April saw three key changes to combat:

[b]Power Swapping: [/b]Every battle you have 3 power swaps, allowing you to swap out a tame and use a move from the new tame in the same turn.

[b]Wild Card Moves:[/b] Each tame has three base moves that can be unlocked with just one limb. These moves don’t require building a stack to use.

[b]Stat Allocation:[/b] For further customization of your tames, you can now allocate attack, special attack, defense, special defense, and agility stats to create the perfect build.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/stat-allocation.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Tames Designed By You[/b][/h3]

This month we designed [b]two new tames [/b]with the community. The Bull Tame (name undecided) had its moveset designed over livestream. This livestream resulted in a taunt-heavy, armoured, retaliating tame. Bull Tame is one to watch for! [url=https://youtu.be/iNCooCNksNQ]Watch the video here.[/url]

Next our community was put to the task of visually designing a brand new Monkey Tame (name undecided). Picture an adorable and wise tamarin monkey and you’ve got the idea!

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/monkey-draw.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Player & NPCs[/b][/h3]

NPC fans rejoice! We made huge progress on our NPCs including completing rival NPCs and rogue faction NPCs. Pirate and hunter faction NPCs are currently in progress.

Big updates have also been made on the character customizer and new clothing items for tamers are also being produced.

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/npc.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Merch[/b][/h3]

You asked and we answered. New merch has now been added to the store with unique tames designs: shirts, hoodies, stickers and more. The Pocket Tame Collection features pocket-sized chibi versions of your favourite tames. The Spring Collection features adorable flowery tame designs.

[url=https://untamedisles.com/product-tag/pocket-tame-collection/]View the Pocket Tame Collection[/url]

[url=https://untamedisles.com/product-tag/spring-collection/]View the Spring Collection[/url]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/merch.png[/img]

[h3][b]Phat Chat Podcast[/b][/h3]

You like video games, we like video games, let’s catch up! Some of our team members from the studio have partnered up on a new project, [url=https://youtu.be/UCOrYpIUTkI] The Phat Chat Podcast[/url]. We discuss the state of video games, retro games, the MMO industry and more.

[url=https://youtu.be/UCOrYpIUTkI][img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/phat-chat.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]And more[/b][/h3]

There are some more updates from our Programming, Art and Music teams. We all appreciate your interest in Untamed Isles and want to provide you the most transparent and detailed updates possible. Thanks for being with us!

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/DeveloperUpdate_02_April.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/untamedisles][img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Untamed_Isles_Steam_BannerDiscord.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Closed Beta Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Settlement_Center_web.jpg[/img]

Hey Tamers,

We are so happy to share the closed beta date and other news with you! Let's hear quotes directly from Josh, our Lead Game Designer.

[h2]Closed Beta Announcement Teaser[/h2]
"We're going to be going into our first closed beta period on the 18th of March. So that's 16 days from now in NZ or the 17th of March for the US."

[previewyoutube=c0c1jQnWGLI;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=WJU-pXCgadw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Closed Beta Round 1 Plan[/h2]
We will be starting with Round 1, The Tame Round. Create your dream tames, and develop skills for certain tames. Here's what Josh has to say:

"We’ve removed 1v1 as the primary gaming mode so now dual battles are the new norm. All of the primary battles of our game now have two tames on field - one tamer, two tames. This is because during play testing we ascertained that it’s a lot more fun, it created a lot more diversity in builds and it generally provided more elements for game play.
We still have 2v2 and 3v3 game modes."

"Four tames will be available with full kits being Thoona, Skelt, Brackis, and Burrl. We’re excited to announce our tame forge. The big pretence to closed beta round 1 is that we’re beginning to really refine down on our feedback on combat and PVP and get our combat system to the place it needs to be.
So, what will tame forge allow you to do? It will allow you to choose a mood/colour of the tame. You will be able to select skills based on the limbs that you have selected. You will be able to select the levels and allocate stats based on the levels. You can fully limb swap. You’ve got a tone of presets you can create, you can save them, you can battle your friends."

"We’re putting in a very basic ELO system so that while you’re battling your friends, you can go up and down an ELO ladder to see where you came during the test. It’s not our full ELO system, but during closed beta we will play with it, adjust it, and modify it until we get to a happy place. For now, it’s just something fun for you while you’re all battling so that you can rank up against each other."

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/UI_closedbetaround1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Merch store launch[/h2]
"Our marketing team have been working diligently putting contracts together with different manufacturers and labels to put together a range of merch. You can see things like t shirts, hoodies, hats, stickers, laptop sleeves and more in our merch store. The public will have access on the 14th of March - just four days before closed beta starts."

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/MerchIsComingInsta.png[/img]

[b]Early Access[/b] [u](Valentine's Day competition winners)[/u]: 07.03 (NZ time)
[b]Public Access:[/b] 14.03 (NZ time)
[b]Merch store products:[/b] t-shirts, hoodies, hats, stickers, mouse pads, laptop sleeves & more

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
We are so excited to reveal the roadmap our team are working to. Here's our Lead Game Designer Josh back to share some thoughts:

"As always, I wanted to emphasise the roadmap is subject to change. I’ve advised the team to work sensibly, to find a good work life balance to not work late, work in the weekends or burn out. I don’t believe in that grind and I just want the team to focus on building a good product and taking the time that it needs.

"Some of the line items may be moved, others may be added, so let’s just keep an open mind."

[b]Round 1 - The Tame Round[/b]
"This is all about playing with tame forge and being able to mix and match tames and control the builds you make to really test things out."
"We will be collecting data from all of the players during live balancing. We’re going to be looking at what combinations of tames are performing really well or over-performing and balancing combat."

[b]Round 2 - The combat round[/b]
"This is when we really push deeper into combat and make some adjustments based on the feedback. We’re looking at adding the ability to Scry here. This will allow you to look at an enemy tame to see their make ups, passives, subtypes, limb combinations."
"Post battle breakdowns after the battles will be available, just some real basic post battle stats. The duel configurator will give the ability to pick how many tames are in a battle, whether it’s 2v2 or 3v3 and preset custom matches."

[b]Round 3- The Exploration Round[/b]
"This is the first time we’re going to really open the island and let you have a good run around. We do have settlement island ready to go, but without NPC and tame encounters, it takes away from the experience. It didn’t make sense to have you guys wandering around a big empty world and it’s not a good representation of our world. We wanted to give you guys a good look and feel of our world when there was more to offer."

"Grass encounters will enable you to encounter wild tames. The exploration servers and the tame forge servers will be separate. So you can’t level up max tames in the forger and bring them into the exploration server."

[b]Round 4[/b]
"We’re bringing in our loot system, our inscription equipment, our inventory system, the P2P trading system. You will be able to fight NPCs, wild tames, get loot. You can equip tames with equipment on top of all these good things."

[b]Open Beta[/b]
"We won’t get into this too much now. Open beta offers the ability for everyone with a game key to join the game. The goal of open beta will largely be to leave servers up at all times and to follow less rounds and more of a patch progress, like what you’re used to in a traditional MMORPG."

"Open beta will offer tutorial, questions, auction house, the breeding system, cosmetics, the wild area, events arena… all the little features that tie the game together that we want to test and refine with you guys."

So guys, that’s the journey, thank you so much for being so patient with us. We’re aiming to bring a good game and we don’t feel like not rushing something that’s not ready or polished to market. It’s an ambitious title for a new studio, we are well-funded and we are aggressively hiring talent, we’re not being naïve, about this, it is just a big job."

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Untamed-Isles-Roadmap-02-03-2022.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/untamedisles][img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Untamed_Isles_Steam_BannerDiscord.png[/img][/url]

tags.feature: We’ve removed 1v1 as the primary gaming mode so now dual battles are the new norm. All of the primary battles of our game now have two tames on field - one tamer, two tames.

Four tames will be available with full kits being Thoona, Skelt, Brackis, and Burrl. We’re excited to announce our tame forge. The big pretence to closed beta round 1 is that we’re beginning to really refine down on our feedback on combat and PVP and get our combat system to the place it needs to be.

So, what will tame forge allow you to do? It will allow you to choose a mood/colour of the tame. You will be able to select skills based on the limbs that you have selected. You will be able to select the levels and allocate stats based on the levels. You can fully limb swap. You’ve got a tone of presets you can create, you can save them, you can battle your friends.

We’re putting in a very basic ELO system so that while you’re battling your friends, you can go up and down an ELO ladder to see where you came during the test. It’s not our full ELO system, but during closed beta we will play with it, adjust it, and modify it until we get to a happy place. For now, it’s just something fun for you while you’re all battling so that you can rank up against each other.

Our marketing team have been working diligently putting contracts together with different manufacturers and labels to put together a range of merch. You can see things like t shirts, hoodies, hats, stickers, laptop sleeves and more in our merch store. The public will have access on the 14th of March - just four days before closed beta starts.

tags.balance_change: We will be collecting data from all of the players during live balancing. We’re going to be looking at what combinations of tames are performing really well or over-performing and balancing combat.

tags.feature: This is when we really push deeper into combat and make some adjustments based on the feedback. We’re looking at adding the ability to Scry here. This will allow you to look at an enemy tame to see their make ups, passives, subtypes, limb combinations.

Post battle breakdowns after the battles will be available, just some real basic post battle stats. The duel configurator will give the ability to pick how many tames are in a battle, whether it’s 2v2 or 3v3 and preset custom matches.

This is the first time we’re going to really open the island and let you have a good run around. We do have settlement island ready to go, but without NPC and tame encounters, it takes away from the experience. It didn’t make sense to have you guys wandering around a big empty world and it’s not a good representation of our world. We wanted to give you guys a good look and feel of our world when there was more to offer.

Grass encounters will enable you to encounter wild tames. The exploration servers and the tame forge servers will be separate. So you can’t level up max tames in the forger and bring them into the exploration server.

We’re bringing in our loot system, our inscription equipment, our inventory system, the P2P trading system. You will be able to fight NPCs, wild tames, get loot. You can equip tames with equipment on top of all these good things.

Open beta offers the ability for everyone with a game key to join the game. The goal of open beta will largely be to leave servers up at all times and to follow less rounds and more of a patch progress, like what you’re used to in a traditional MMORPG.

Open beta will offer tutorial, questions, auction house, the breeding system, cosmetics, the wild area, events arena… all the little features that tie the game together that we want to test and refine with you guys.

notes.title: End of the year 2021 update
notes.content:
[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Christmas-Showcase-web.jpg[/img]

[b]End of the year update, Kickstarter fulfilment info, Steam store page, new content and other news of 2021 are waiting for you in this post. Let’s dive into it![/b]

First of all, we would like to wish you and your families all the best for 2022! This year is going to be very exciting, and we have lots planned for the next 12 months. We can’t wait to finally welcome players to enjoy Untamed Isles!



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Untamed-Community-Header.png[/img]

The Untamed Community has been the highlight of our year. We couldn’t ask for a more helpful or supportive community, and the fan art you all have been creating has been incredible.



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Steam-Page-Header.png[/img]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Untamed_Isles_Steam_Page.png[/img]

We now have [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823300/Untamed_Isles/]the Untamed Isles page live on Steam[/url]! This is a huge milestone for us personally, and we are looking forward to seeing our Steam community grow. You can check out the latest content and info, add Untamed Isles to your wishlist and start discussions with fellow tamers in Community Hub.



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Steam-Keys-Header.png[/img]

We’ve also just recently sent out Steam keys to our Pre-beta backers (Pathfinder and above). By redeeming those keys in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823300/Untamed_Isles/]the Steam store[/url], you’ll have your copy of Untamed Isles added to your library and will be able to participate in future game tests. More keys will be sent out as we approach the closed beta and then towards the early access. If you are a backer with pre-beta access and you haven’t received your Steam key, please [url=mailto:info@untamedisles.com]contact us[/url].



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Game-Development-Header.png[/img]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Tame_Swap_Combat_UI_Mock_Finley_Power.jpg[/img]

Development is in full motion as we move from feature test to feature test. The new year holds huge feature updates and beta access for our tamers. We have added a weekly update on our socials, website and discord that covers our development and design updates. We will be locking in and announcing dates for our closed and open beta soon.



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Testing-Header.png[/img]

Testing has well and truly begun, we are currently holding regular Pre-Beta testing and are working rapidly towards closed beta. Thanks so much for all of the community support during these tests. A holiday hat cosmetic will be issued to all participants.



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Weekly-Content-Drops-Headers.png[/img]

[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/FruitCatching-Showcase-web.jpg[/img]

We’ve recently started doing [url=https://untamedisles.com/tag/content-drop/]weekly content drops[/url] to share visual updates on the game development process. Every week, we pick fresh art, texture tests, vfx videos, user interface concepts, screenshots and other content from Untamed Isles. This content is available on our website with the link to download files. We encourage creators to use it for their own videos and social media posts.



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/The-Path-Awakens-Header.png[/img]

We have also released our first book [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09HRQHTD8]“The Path Awakens” by Aaron Hodges[/url]. It is already collecting some outstanding reviews. Set 12 months before the players arrive, The Path Awakens follows the story of the Pathfinders, the very first to discover and explore the Untamed Isles and is a beautiful introduction to the world we are building.



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Phat-Loot-Studios.png[/img]

As a company we have also seen enormous growth, our staff count growing from around 10 to upwards of 40 and continuing to grow. We have formed a new branch of our company called Phat Loot Defi. They have already produced their first project, an NFT generative art project named [url=https://guppygang.io/]Guppy Gang[/url], which was a huge success.



[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Rewards-Header.png[/img]

Kickstarter was a huge success and we would like to thank all our supporters! We have multiple rewards we are working on, so let’s take a quick look at the fulfilment process.

[b]Access[/b]
• Pre-Beta - Tests are currently running, Steam keys were sent out this week
• Closed Beta - TBC, will be early 2022
• Open Beta - Will follow the Closed Beta
• Early Access Launch - To be announced following the Open Beta period

[b]Digital Goods[/b]
• Discord Ranks - Redeemed
• In-game Title - To be redeemed at launch
• Digital Wallpaper - January 2022
• Digital Handbook - In works
• In-game Items, Mounts and Cosmetic Outfits - To be redeemed at launch
• Soundtrack - In works
• Housing - Redeemable with housing expansion patch, expected mid to late 2022
• Alchemist Monster Creation - 2 Designs complete and being 3d modelled.

[b]Physical Goods[/b]
• Signed Books - Signed and ready to be shipped, waiting for the shirts to be printed and sent together
• Survivalists Custom Guppy Portraits - January 2022
• Shirts and Hoodies - Printing starts on January 17th
[u]Unfortunately, our first supplier did not meet our quality expectations, so we have moved to a local New Zealand supplier who is producing some excellent shirts with stunningly vivid prints. The only downside is that the Christmas and New Years break has resulted in them not being able to print until the 17th.[/u]
• Property concept art - Redeemable with housing expansion patch, expected mid to late 2022


[img]https://untamedisles.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/BugNet_UntamedIsles_web.jpg[/img]

[b]We would like to say a huge thank you for all your support in 2021! It was a big year for our team and community, and we are very excited to welcome all players to Untamed Isles in 2022. We are going to have a massive in-game party for next year’s holidays and you’re all invited![/b]

[u]The Untamed Isles Team[/u]
